name: popnei
description: Population genetics over the variants of a dataset

scripts.build: npm install --no-fund --no-audit && npm run build:wasm && npm run build:ts
scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --package popnei-js --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target web --remove-name-section --out-dir wasm --out-name popnei ../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/popnei_js.wasm
